title: Separating lawful and unlawful promises
summary: Severability asks whether an enforceable part of an arrangement can be separated from a term or undertaking affected by a legal defect.
notes: The public-policy readings examine the relationship between the challenged conduct, the bargain being enforced, and the consequences of refusal. Identify the actual promises and the governing rule instead of assuming that one unlawful circumstance invalidates every associated obligation.

textbookImport.basis: Plain-language synthesis of the cited casebook passages; subject to the jurisdictional and source limits stated there.
